Chairman Statement

主席報告



      本 人 欣然向各 位 股東提呈本 公
      司 及 本 集 團 二 零 一八 年 十二月
      三十一日止之年度業務回顧與展望。


      二零一八年，中國經濟堅持「六穩 」，
      做 到了兼 顧 穩 增長和防風 險 的平衡。 中
      國 GDP 同比增長 6.6%，面對錯綜覆雜的國際
      環境和艱巨的國內改革發展任務，經濟運行保持在
      合理區間， 總體平穩、 穩中有進的態勢持續顯現。 中央堅持
      房子是用來住的、不是用來炒的定位，因城 施策、分類指導，擴大土地多元化供
      應，增加政策性支持住房供應，加快完善住房保障體系，出台租賃市場支持政策，
      推進房地產長效機制的構建，促進房地產市場健康發展。

      I am pleased to present the annual business review and outlook of the Company and the Group
      for the year ended 31 December 2018 to shareholders.

      In year 2018, China’s economy well balanced between steady growth and risk prevention by
      adhering to the “six stabilities” policy and delivered GDP growth of 6.6%. Facing complicated
      international environment and arduous domestic challenges in reform, development and
      stabilization, Chinese government successfully kept the key economic indicators within an
      appropriate range and maintained economic stability while making steady progress. While
      adhering to the principle of “housing is for living rather than speculation”, central government
      implemented city-specific policies and category-specific guidance, increased land supply
      through diversified channels and policy-supported housing supply, accelerated improvement of
       the housing social welfare system, introduced policies to support leasing markets, pledged to

董事會之責任                                RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE BOARD
董事會負責制訂本公司的戰略、目標及業務計劃，                The Board is responsible for the formulation of strategies, objectives and
監督及控制本公司的戰略執行、營運及財務表現，                business plans for the Company, and to supervise and control the
並制定適當的風險控制政策與程序，以確保實現                 implementation of strategies of the Company and its operations and financial
本公司之戰略目標。此外，董事會亦負責將本公                 performance, and formulation of appropriate risk control policies and
司之企業管治維持於高水平。董事負責促進本公                 procedures to ensure the achievement of the Company’s strategic
司之成功，以及客觀地作出符合本公司最佳利益                 objectives. In addition, the Board is also responsible for maintaining a high
之決定。                                  standard of corporate governance of the Company. The Directors are
                                      accountable for promoting the success of the Company and making
                                      decisions objectively in the best interests of the Company.


為保持高效運作和經營決策的靈活與迅捷，董事                 In order to maintain a highly efficient operation, as well as flexibility and
會必要時亦將其管理及行政權力轉授予管理層，                 swiftness in operational decision-making, the Board, when necessary, may
並就授權行為提供清晰的指引，以避免嚴重妨礙                 delegate its managing and administrative powers to the management, and
或削弱董事會整體履行其職權的能力。管理層定                 provide clear guidance regarding such delegation so as to avoid seriously
期會面，檢討本公司之戰略目標、企業架構、營                 impeding or undermining the overall capabilities of the Board in exercising its
運程序、預算執行、主要項目及經營計劃。轉授                 powers. The management meets regularly to review the strategic goals,
予各董事委員會的職責及權力載於下文各部份。                 corporate structure, operating procedures, budget implementation, major
                                      projects and business plans of the Company. Duties and authorities
                                      delegated to the various board committees are described in the respective
                                      sessions below.


董事會應具備平衡的技巧及經驗以切合本公司業                 The Board should have a balance of skills and experience appropriate for the
務所需。執行董事及非執行董事的平衡架構有助                 requirements of the business of the Company. A balanced composition of
於確保董事會的獨立性並可令董事會作出有效的                 executive directors and non-executive directors helps to ensure the
獨立判斷。董事會的運作及管理及本公司業務的                 independence of the Board and enables the Board to make independent
日常管理應在董事會的層面清晰劃分以確保權力                 judgments effectively. The operation and management of the Board and the
及授權的平衡，而該權力將不會集中於任何個人。                day-to-day management of the Company’s business should be clearly
                                      divided at the Board level to ensure that there is a balance of power and
                                      authority and that power will not be concentrated in any one individual.

本公司於二零一八年十二月四日修訂了董事多元                 The Company revised the Board Diversity Policy on 4 December 2018,
化政策，並於二零一九年一月一日起生效。根據                 effective from 1 January 2019. Pursuant to the updated Board Diversity
最新董事會多元化政策：為達致可持續的均衡發                 Policy, with a view achieve a sustainable and balanced development, the
展，本公司視董事會層面日益多元化為支持其達                 Company sees increasing diversity at the Board level as an essential element
到戰略目標及維持可持續發展的關鍵元素。本公                 in supporting the attainment of its strategic objectives and its sustainable
司在設定董事會成員組合時，會從多個方面考慮                 development. In designing the Board’s composition, Board diversity has been
董事會成員多元化，包括但不限於文化及教育背                 considered from a number of aspects, including but not limited to cultural

風險管理及內部監控                               RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL
董事會高度關注並全面負責維持本集團穩健有效                   The Board highly values and has the overall responsibility for maintaining
的風險管理及內部監控系統，以保障本集團財產                   appropriate and effective risk management and internal control systems to
及利益相關者之權益，並有責任檢討該系統之效                   safeguard the Group’s assets and stakeholders’ interests, as well as for
率。為履行責任，董事會持續監督管理層對風險                   reviewing the effectiveness of the systems. To fulfill its responsibility, the
管理及內部監控系統的設計、實施及監察，透過                   Board oversees management in the design, implementation and monitoring
成熟的組織架構、政策和程序的制訂、授權的界                   of the risk management and internal control systems to ensure the
定基準等確保本公司維持風險管理及內部監控系                   effectiveness of such systems through well-established organizational
統的有效性。                                  structure, appropriate policies and procedures in place, as well as clearly
                                        defined lines of authority and responsibility.


董事會定期審閱及監察風險管理及內部監控系統                   The Board oversees the Company’s risk management and internal control
的成效。本公司於二零一五年經修訂將風險管理                   systems on an ongoing basis. The Company amended the terms of reference
納入本公司審核委員會職責範圍，以進一步加強                   of the Audit Committee in 2015 to further enhance the risk management and
本集團的風險管理及內部監控。董事會透過審核                   internal control functions of the Company. The Board assesses the
委員會、執行管理層以及內部審核部門（「內審部」）                effectiveness of the risk management and internal control systems through
和外聘核數師之檢討，對風險管理及內部監控系                   the reviews performed by the Audit Committee, executive management,
統 之 效 益 作 出 評 估。於 截 至 二 零 一 八 年 十 二 月   internal audit department (“Internal Audit Department”) and external

關鍵審核事項                                             KEY AUDIT MATTERS
關鍵審核事項是根據我們的專業判斷，認為對本                              Key audit matters are those matters that, in our professional judgement,
期間綜合財務報表的審核最為重要的事項。該等                              were of most significance in our audit of the consolidated financial
事項於我們審核整體綜合財務報表及出具意見時                              statements of the current period. These matters were addressed in the
進行處理，而我們不會對該等事項提供單獨的意                              context of our audit of the consolidated financial statements as a whole, and
見。就下文各事項而言，我們的審計如何處理關                              in forming our opinion thereon, and we do not provide a separate opinion on

2.1 呈列貨幣變更                            2.1 CHANGE OF PRESENTATION CURRENCY
      本公司的功能貨幣為人民幣。過往財政年度                  The Company’s functional currency is Renminbi (“RMB”). The
      綜合財務報表的呈列貨幣為港幣。                      presentation currency of the consolidated financial statements in the
                                           prior financial year was Hong Kong dollars (HK$).


      由於本公司及其附屬公司（統稱「本集團」）                 Since the Company and its subsidiaries (together, the “Group”) mainly
      主要於中國內地經營其業務，且本集團大部                  operates its business in the Mainland China and most of the assets
      分資產及負債以人民幣計值，故本公司董事                  and liabilities of the Group are denominated in RMB, the directors of
      認為將人民幣用作本集團的呈列貨幣更合                   the Company consider that it is more appropriate to use RMB as the
      適，及以人民幣呈列財務報表可為管理層提                  presentation currency of the Group and the presentation of financial
      供更多相關資料以控制及監控本集團的表現                  statements in RMB can provide more relevant information for
      及財務狀況。因此，由二零一八年一月一日                  management to control and monitor the performance and financial
      起，本集團將編製財務報表的呈列貨幣由港                  position of the Group. Accordingly, the Group has changed its
      幣改為人民幣。比較數字經已重列，以與本                  presentation currency for the preparation of the financial statements
      年度以人民幣呈列保持一致。                        from HK$ to RMB starting from 1 January 2018. The comparative
                                           figures have been restated to conform with the current year’s
                                           presentation in RMB.

      估市場參與者是否有能力獲得業務並繼續創             needed to create outputs. The amendments remove the assessment

      重大貢獻。修訂本亦將成果的定義收窄至專             acquired inputs and acquired substantive processes together

      來自日常業務的其他收入。此外，修訂本對             amendments have also narrowed the definition of outputs to focus on

      入可自選的公平值集中測試，允許簡化評估             income from ordinary activities. Furthermore, the amendments

     一般方法                                   GENERAL APPROACH
     預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就自初次確                    ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which
     認起未有大幅增加的信貸風險而言，預期信                    there has not been a significant increase in credit risk since initial
     貸虧損就由未來 12 個月內可能發生違約事                  recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from default
     件而導致的信貸虧損計提撥備（12 個月預期                  events that are possible within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL).
     信貸虧損）
         。就自初次確認起大幅增加的信                     For those credit exposures for which there has been a significant
     貸風險而言，不論發生違約時間，均須就於                    increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss allowance is
     餘下風險年期內的預期信貸虧損計提虧損撥                    required for credit losses expected over the remaining life of the
     備（全期預期信貸虧損）。                           exposure, irrespective of the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).


     本集團於各報告日期評估金融工具的信貸風                    At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the credit risk on
     險是否自初次確認以來大幅增加。進行評估                    a financial instrument has increased significantly since initial
     時，本集團比較於報告日期金融工具發生違                    recognition. When making the assessment, the Group compares the

     即可取得的合理可靠資料，包括歷史及前瞻                    instrument as at the date of initial recognition and considers
     性資料。                                   reasonable and supportable information that is available without
                                            undue cost or effort, including historical and forward-looking
                                            information.


     本集團於合約付款逾期 45 日時將金融資產                  The Group considers a financial asset in default when contractual

            估值採用之估值方法包括已落成物業所用                               The valuation methodologies adopted in valuations include the income
            之收入法及直接比較法，以及在建物業所                               approach and the direct comparison approach for the completed
            用之餘值估價法、直接比較法及成本法。                               properties and the residual approach, the direct comparison approach
                                                             and the cost approach for the properties under construction.

            收入法透過計及自現有租約產生之物業租                               The income approach operates by taking into account the rental income
            金 收 入， 並 適 當 計 及 租 約 之 復 歸 收 入 潛                 of the property derived from the existing tenancy with due allowance for
            力，然後按適當的資本化率將其資本化為                               the reversionary income potential of the tenancy, which are then
            若干價值。                                            capitalised into the value at an appropriate capitalisation rate.

            直接比較法涉及就近期同類物業的市場銷                               The direct comparison approach involves the analysis of recent market
            售案例與估值項目物業進行比較分析。每                               sales evidence of similar properties to compare with the premises under
            項比較以其單位比率為基準進行分析，比                               valuation. Each comparable is analysed on the basis of its unit rate; each
            較的各項屬性其後與主體項目進行比較，                               attribute of the comparable is then compared with the subject and where
            如有差異，則調整單位比率，為主體項目                               there is a difference, the unit rate is adjusted in order to arrive at the
            達致合適的單位比率。                                       appropriate unit rate for the subject.

48. 資本風險管理                      48. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
      本集團管理資本以確保本集團各實體可以持          The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
      續經營，並通過優化債務及權益結餘為股東          be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
      帶來最大回報。本集團之整體策略與上年度          shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.
      保持一致。                        The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from the prior year.


      本集團之資本架構包括淨債務（包括於附註          The capital structure of the Group consists of net debts, which includes
      34 披露之銀行借貸、附註 35 披露之優先票      the bank borrowings disclosed in note 34, the senior notes disclosed
      據及於附註 36 披露之中期票據）
                      （扣除現金        in note 35 and medium-term notes disclosed in note 36, net of cash
      及現金等值）
           、應付最終控股公司款項、應           and cash equivalents, amount due to the ultimate holding company,
      付中間控股公司款項、應付同系附屬公司款          amounts due to intermediate holding companies, amounts due to
      項、應付合營企業款項、應付聯營公司款           fellow subsidiaries, amounts due to joint ventures, amounts due to
      項、應付非控股權益款項以及本公司擁有人          associates, amounts due to non-controlling interests and equity
      應佔權益（包括已發行股本及其他儲備）。          attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share
                                   capital, and other reserves.


      本公司董事定期檢討資本架構。於檢討時，          The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
      董事考慮資本成本及與各資本類別相關之風          basis. As part of this review, the directors consider the cost of capital
      險。根據董事之建議，本集團將透過支付股          and the risks associate with each class of capital. Based on
      息、發行新股、購回股份及發行新債務或贖          recommendations of the directors, the Group will balance its overall
      回現有債務，平衡整體資本架構。              capital structure through the payment of dividends, new share issues
                                   and share buy-backs as well as the issue of new debts or the
                                   redemption of existing debts.

    本集團為駐香港僱員參與強制性公積金計劃                     The Group participates in a mandatory provident fund scheme (“MPF
   （「強積金計劃」
          ）。強積金計劃為根據強制性                     Scheme”) for its employees in Hong Kong. MPF Scheme is a defined
    公積金計劃條例原則制訂的界定供款計劃。                     contribution scheme in accordance with the principle of the Mandatory
    根據強積金計劃規則，僱主及僱員須按僱員                     Provident Fund Schemes Ordinance. Under the rules of MPF Scheme,
    薪金 5% 供款，每月供款上限為每名僱員港                   the employer and its employees are required to contribute 5% of the
    幣 1,500 元。強積金計劃資產由獨立管理基                 employee’s salaries, up to a maximum of HK$1,500 per employee per
    金持有，與集團公司資產分開持有。                        month. The assets of the MPF Scheme are held separately from those
                                            of the group companies in an independently administered fund.


    本集團於中國之僱員為中國各地方政府經營                     The employees of the Group in the PRC are members of state
    的國家管理退休福利計劃之成員。本集團須                     managed retirement benefit schemes operated by the respective local
    按特定薪金成本百分比向計劃作指定供款，                     government in the PRC. The Group is required to contribute a specified
    作為福利計劃之資金。本集團就該等計劃之                     percentage of payroll costs to the schemes to fund the benefits. The
    唯一責任為作出指定供款。                            only obligation of the Group with respect to these schemes is to make
